title: As Nepal identifies those killed in the floods, questions grow over China's reporting
content: One week after the deadly floods, very little is known about China's dead or missing. China's control over media and digital censorship is in stark contrast to open reporting in Nepal.

title: 5 dead after crash at Miami Airport. And, Germany's far-right wins state election
content: A cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport has left five people dead and several others injured. And, Germany's far-right AfD party achieves an electoral victory in a key state election.

title: The copper peptide trend has gone from creams to injections — ahead of the science
content: The peptide is supposed to deliver flawless and firm skin, promote wound healing and other anti-aging effects. So what's the evidence behind GHK-Cu?

title: The first day of school: Bells, bikes, buses and big feelings
content: Fifth graders calm school kindergartners in Los Angeles. Kids take the "bike bus" in Oklahoma. High school students take in a new high school building in Oregon.

title: 'Her body temperature was 106': How heat is killing Americans in their homes
content: Heat kills thousands of people across the U.S. every year. The risk is especially high for the millions of Americans who live in manufactured housing like mobile homes and trailers.

title: Morning news brief
content: Five people are dead after a cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport, Trump's top envoys go to Ukraine with hopes of restarting peace talks, Germany's far-right party wins landslide victory.

title: Investigators seek answers after Amazon cargo plane crash kills five at Miami airport
content: An Amazon Prime cargo plane was landing at the airport around 2 p.m. ET on Sunday when it overran the runway, crashed and rammed into vehicles on the ground, according to FAA.

title: Germany's far-right achieves an electoral breakthrough in key state election
content: Germany's populist, far-right Alternative for Germany party has declared victory in the state of Saxony-Anhalt after more than doubling its share of the vote in the first of several regional elections this fall.

title: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover
content: Even as anti-Muslim rhetoric rises in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are winning over diners and reshaping one of the state's most iconic culinary traditions.

title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
content: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.
